allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on February 05, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 15, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 15 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 1400 per share.
